title: Qworld: Question-Specific Evaluation Criteria for LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge against dynamically generated, question-specific criteria that explicitly score for cultural sensitivity, respect for local customs, and adaptability to cultural constraints.

Evaluating open-ended model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge against dynamically generated criteria that measure health equity, affordability, and the accessibility of recommendations for resource-limited settings.
